==Related skills==
*{{Skill icon|Sunspear Battle Call}}

==Notes==
*This [[buff]] grants characters a base [[health]] of 480 and bonuses to their [[attribute]]s, and replaces their current [[armor rating]] with the [[Basic armor|max armor rating]] for that [[profession]] until they reach level 20. 
**This buff sets one attribute to rank 12 and three additional attributes to rank 9. The effect overrides the character's current ranks in all attributes and places 12 ranks in the attribute of the [[weapon]] the character is wielding, 9 ranks in that character's [[primary attribute]], 9 ranks based on the attribute of the [[focus]] or [[shield]] the character had equipped (if applicable), and 9 ranks based on the skills on the character's [[skill bar]] until the character has three attributes with 9 ranks in them.
**If the attribute of the weapon the character is wielding isn't available to that character, no attribute will be set to 12 and instead you will get four attributes with 9 ranks in each.
**Upon reaching level 20, this buff goes away the next time that character enters a new [[zone]]. 
**[[Rune]]s on your [[armor]] which boost attributes have no effect, including any potential penalty such as the -75 health for a superior rune.
**Skills which boost your attributes such as [[Glyph of Elemental Power]] or [[Awaken the Blood]] have no effect on your attributes while under the effects of this buff.
*[[Hero]]es are not affected by this buff.
*[[Weakness]] does not reduce your attributes when you are buffed by this.
*Despite the description saying you will be treated as a level 20 character:
** You still gain [[experience]] as if you were your actual, lower level.
** [[Summoning Stone]]s use your actual level.

==Trivia==
*"Don't stop believing" comes from a [[W:Don't Stop Believin'|song by the same name]] by the band [[W:Journey (band)|Journey]].
*The mountain shown in the picture appears to be the [[w:Matterhorn|Matterhorn]], in the Alps.
